title: BasketCheckedOutV1
description: A basket has been checked out and cleared as part of a successful order placement. Version 1. Immutable once committed: any change to this event's shape ships as BasketCheckedOut.v2.schema.json, never as an edit to this file.

eventId.description: Unique identifier of this event instance, so a consumer can deduplicate a redelivered message.

occurredAtUtc.description: When the basket was cleared as part of checkout, in UTC.

customerRef.description: Maps to Basket.CustomerRef, the caller's resolved subject id.

tenantId.description: The tenant the basket belongs to. Required here even though BasketResponse does not yet surface it: the contract is authored ahead of the publisher that will satisfy it.

correlationId.description: The correlation id generated at the edge and threaded through the checkout request.

items.description: The lines that were checked out. Checkout of an empty basket is rejected upstream, so in practice there is always at least one.

basketLineItemV1.title: BasketLineItemV1
basketLineItemV1.description: A single checked-out line. Not independently versioned: it changes only when BasketCheckedOutV1 does.

lineTotal.description: Maps to BasketLineItemResponse.LineTotal. Money arithmetic stays in the owning service, never recomputed by a consumer.
